name: momentum-strong
description: T-022 operator packet, run A of two: the SAME build and the SAME URL (index.html?momentum=1) played WELL. The policy is six-face-aimed-run.json's verbatim (hold fire, hold right, tilt the gun up at anything above the firing line, face the threat inside a gate, jump at the lip of a hole) — the only reflex set measured to clear wave gates. What it demonstrates is not that the bot is good, it is that the pace ANSWERS: this policy keeps RIG toward the right of the screen, banks daylight against the pursuing plane, and the pursuing edge escalates above the shipped 4.3 t/s. READ IT OUT OF `report.json` -> `trace` (the per-sample array; the report has no `samples` key): each entry carries the frozen `pursuitSpeed` telemetry field, drive = (pursuitSpeed/4.3 - 1)/0.4, and `hudTR` carries the on-screen MOMENTUM meter for the same instant. READ THE STRUCTURAL GAP, NOT THE DECIMALS (I-029). What reproduces across independent pairs is the SEPARATION between this run and momentum-weak.json on the same build and the same URL: a 12-13x difference in the fraction of PLAYING samples spent above the shipped pace, a peak near x1.27 here against x1.00-1.05 there, and the weak policy never crossing the x1.12 bound. The only COMMITTED measurement of that pair is the T-022 gate's, in reports/tasks/T-022/playtest.md section 4: strong 60.8% / 80.2% of PLAYING samples above the floor with peaks x1.265 / x1.280 and maxScroll 118.4 / 140.0, weak 0.7% / 11.6% with peaks x1.008 / x1.025 and maxScroll 75.0 both. TWO RUNS PER SIDE IS A SAMPLE, NOT A BASELINE: the builder's own pair and the gate's landed outside several of each other's bands (section 10, and I-029 in SPRINT.md), and the run directories both were read from (tools/playtest/runs/gate-T-022-*) are gitignored and are not in the tree — so the per-run decimals this description used to quote have been dropped rather than restated. --deterministic pins input to gameMs but not the browser's frame cadence, so that spread is expected; do not read any decimal here as a regression baseline. Run it as: --deterministic, 1440x900, `--max-runtime-ms 62000` (the 60 s window needs that cap raised off its 25000 ms default or the run is cut at ~25 s). It does NOT reach VICTORY, and no bot run has (docs/playtests/2026-08-victory-box.md).
